entity_raw.definition_raw: Smoke SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): FireAssociated Deities: Angradd, Asmodeus, Brigh, Chavazvug, Feronia, Flauros, Hastrikhal, Kro'akoth, Lady Nanbyo, Mhar, Moloch, Nataka, Nurgal, Ptah, Rubicante, Sezelrian, Svarozic, Yabu, Yamatsumi, ZarongelReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the fire bolt power of the Fire domain. Cloud of Smoke (Su): As a standard action, you can create a 5-foot-radius cloud of smoke. This power has a range of 30 feet. Creatures inside the cloud take a –2 penalty on attack rolls and Perception skill checks for as long as they remain inside and for 1 round after exiting the cloud. Creatures inside the cloud gain concealment from attacks made by opponents that are not adjacent to them. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd—pyrotechnics, 3rd—stinking cloud.
